## 2024-07-05 - [HIGH] Fix Insecure Session Management in Supabase Client
**Vulnerability:** Supabase authentication tokens were being stored insecurely in plaintext via `@react-native-async-storage/async-storage` on native mobile platforms.
**Learning:** Expo projects require `expo-secure-store` to securely persist sensitive tokens natively (such as those generated by Supabase Auth). However, `expo-secure-store` throws errors or crashes on Web platforms. A custom storage adapter must be implemented to use secure storage on iOS/Android while falling back gracefully to AsyncStorage on Web environments (`Platform.OS === 'web'`).
**Prevention:** Always use a platform-aware storage adapter that leverages `expo-secure-store` for native devices when configuring `auth.storage` in Supabase (or any similar auth client) in an Expo/React Native project.
